text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The academy and Bubblyland are
holding a
special collaborative event.  I
head my way over,
when...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hey, um, Nakayama?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I think it's about time that you finally tell
me why
we're here...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
El, don't you know what's happening
here today?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Well, I think I heard something about
the
Umamusume Splash Bash. Some kind
of water gun
contest, yeah? You want us
to compete?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You said you wanted to run with me
again, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Then show me some passion. Beat me
here, and
I'll run.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué?! But what do water guns even have
to do
with—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about that. So what're you
going to
do? Fold your hand?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...I'll do it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
BUT! If I win, you definitely have to run
with me
again!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh. Pretty sure I already said that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them register as
contestants in
the Umamusume Splash
Bash.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! El Condor Pasa takes down
three
combatants in quick succession!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thirsty? How about a drink from my
water guns of
fury! There's no escaping
the El Aerial Strike!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You're still in the game, huh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Nakayama!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna lose, and you're gonna
keep that
promise!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly the fire I wanted to see!
Show me
your hand, El!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yes, YES! A total El knockout!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You've got a quick draw that I can't
deny. My
loss.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I was pretty confident I had you, but just
goes to
show—you never know who's
gonna win till it's
over.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Where was this fire when we were
training
together, eh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Close one, but it still looks like you
don't have
what it takes to keep up.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Gah, if only I was quicker on my feet!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm a pretty sharp shot with water guns.
Still, I
have to ask...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Where was this fire when we were
training
together, eh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
When we trained that one time, you
didn't have
this kinda drive—fighting for
the win here and
now, not caring what
comes next.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm seriously putting in everything to get
stronger!
From racing with powerful
rivals to rethinking my
own
approaches—every day's a training
fiesta!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And it's all in the name of racing
overseas!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Well that's... Yeah, maybe...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I was so wrapped up in making it
overseas. I guess
I wasn't focused
enough on winning...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow, after classes are out.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow? What's happening
tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You and me—training. What, lose your
nerve?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: N-not in a million years!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And I'll definitely show you that I'm in it
to win it!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Finally... There's that love of the game I
know all
too well!
